nodes.label: analyzeChildren
nodes.doc: Analyse a `static.children` value: a fixed array / single child / static text of templatable children.

nodes.label: analyzeTemplate
nodes.doc: Analyse whether an `h(...)` call is a templatable subtree — a clonable skeleton whose STRUCTURE is invariant across occurrences, with optional per-instance holes (bindable attributes/text, handlers).

nodes.label: attrHole
nodes.doc: An attribute hole (leading-space form, empty when omitted).

nodes.label: bakeStaticAttr
nodes.doc: Serialize one attribute to its exact bytes when the value is a literal — the same string @exodra/string's spaceAttribute produces at runtime (kept in sync; pinned by the ssr-emit parity tests), so static attrs are BAKED into the literal in…

nodes.label: bindHelperName
nodes.doc: Pick the runtime bind helper at compile time from the element type, so the bundle only pulls the variants actually used.

nodes.label: cleanJSXText
nodes.doc: Clean a JSXText node's value per the JSX whitespace rules (identical to React / Babel): whitespace adjacent to a newline is trimmed and whitespace-only lines are dropped, but a same-line space between text and an expression is SIGNIFICANT …

nodes.label: collectBoundNames
nodes.doc: Every name bound anywhere in the file (params, declarations, imports, catch bindings, …).

nodes.label: compileCallback
nodes.doc: Compile a list callback's JSX body to a string-producing body.

nodes.label: compileChildExpression
nodes.doc: Lower a `{expr}` child to a STRING-producing expression, keeping the data-driven JS control flow but compiling any JSX in it to templates: {arr.map(cb)} → arr.map(compiledCb).join('') {c && <x/>} → c ?

nodes.label: componentRef
nodes.doc: A component reference expression for a capitalized tag (`<Card/>` → `Card`) or a member tag (`<Foo.Bar/>` → `Foo.Bar`); null for an intrinsic (lowercase) tag.

nodes.label: DYNAMIC
nodes.doc: A single statically-known value, or the marker `DYNAMIC` if it can't be known at build time.

nodes.label: emitComponentCall
nodes.doc: A component usage `<Card static={{…}} bindable={{…}}/>` → `${Card(_ctx({…}))}`.

nodes.label: emitFragment
nodes.doc: A fragment: its children concatenated with no wrapper.

nodes.label: emitSsr
nodes.doc: Compile one Exodra JSX element to a SafeHtml template expression.

nodes.label: emitSsrRaw
nodes.doc: Same as emitSsr but WITHOUT the `_html` wrapper — for contexts that stringify the result immediately (list `.map(...).join('')` items), where the wrapper would only add a per-item SafeHtml allocation the `join` then undoes.

nodes.label: escapeStatic
nodes.doc: Compile-time escaping of literal text.

nodes.label: escHole
nodes.doc: `_esc(expr)` — escaped text hole.

nodes.label: foldObject
nodes.doc: Try to fold an object expression to a CSS string.

nodes.label: getTagExpr
nodes.doc: The h() first argument: a component REFERENCE for a capitalized tag (`<Card/>` → `h(Card, …)`) or a member tag (`<Foo.Bar/>` → `h(Foo.Bar, …)`), else the tag name as a string for an intrinsic element (`<div/>` → `h("div", …)`).

nodes.label: HelperNames
nodes.doc: Resolved local names of the runtime helpers.

nodes.label: Helpers
nodes.doc: Emitters for the runtime helpers the compiler references.

nodes.label: innerHtmlOf
nodes.doc: Extract the `__html` value from a `{ __html: ...

nodes.label: isInsideIteration
nodes.doc: True if `path` runs inside a loop or an array-iteration callback — i.e.

nodes.label: isLowercaseTagLiteral
nodes.doc: A plain lowercase element tag literal — not a component (identifier / capitalised) and not a special `#fragment` / `#text` type.

nodes.label: literalValue
nodes.doc: The compile-time JS value of a literal node, or NOT_LITERAL when it is dynamic.

nodes.label: makeHelpers

members.full: (programPath, cfg): { helpers: Helpers; used: Map<string, UsedImport>; localOf: (imported: string, source: string) => string | undefined; }

fullParts.text: >; localOf: (imported: string, source: string) => string | undefined; }

nodes.doc: Build the per-file helper registry.

nodes.label: markedTemplate
nodes.doc: Wrap a built template as SafeHtml so it composes as raw HTML in a parent.

nodes.label: NON_ATTR
nodes.doc: Names that are NOT rendered as attributes (they drive content or lifecycle).

members.doc: 'dom' (default) → compile JSX to h() schemas for the client/DOM renderer.

nodes.label: readSignal
nodes.doc: Read `getValue()` off a signal expression.

nodes.label: shouldHoistSchema
nodes.doc: A fully-static h(type, attrs) call: no reactive buckets, children recursively static.

nodes.label: SsrHelperNames
nodes.doc: Local names for the emitted runtime helpers.

nodes.label: staticAttrPart
nodes.doc: One static attribute → a baked string part (literal value) or a runtime `_a` hole (dynamic).

nodes.label: staticKey
nodes.doc: The static key of an object property: `foo` / `"foo-bar"`.

members.doc: True when the value was wrapped in a runtime `style(...)` call.

nodes.label: tagString
nodes.doc: The element tag as a literal string (intrinsic elements only).

nodes.label: TemplateInfo
nodes.doc: A templatable subtree: the number of DOM nodes it materialises and whether it carries any "holes" (nodes with bindable/handler buckets, patched per instance).

nodes.label: transformStaticStyleProperty
nodes.doc: Transform a single `static` bucket property.

nodes.label: UNITLESS
nodes.doc: Compile-time folding of `static.style` objects.

nodes.label: usedCtx
nodes.doc: Per-file usage of runtime helpers, so the plugin only imports what is emitted: `_ctx` (component context) and `_style` (@exodra/style, for a dynamic `style`).
